messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired PD-84219 for service=redwood-inference-p95 region=us-west. Alert: p95 latency > 1500ms for 5m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-84219
alice: ack — I'm the oncall, grabbing the hotshard dashboard now. :hand:
bob: ondeck, tailing logs and traces, posting interesting spans in a sec.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-84219 acknowledged by alice
carla: any 5xxs or is this pure latency SLO burn?
alice: no extra 5xxs, just latency. Telemetry shows KV cache miss rate jumped ~8x and batch sizes spiked. p99 also up to ~2s.
david: looks like an upstream traffic shift — a few customers increased request fanout. Can we do a routing fallback for lower-priority routes?
alice: yes — planning an immediate soft-fallback to a smaller model for non-critical routes. Executing route swap: `POST /admin/routes/swap {"route":"chat-stream","fallback_model":"mistral-7b-q4"}`
incident-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for route chat-stream -> mistral-7b-q4 (5% traffic)
bob: reducing batch window on the serving pool to shave latency: `PATCH /infra/batcher {"target_ms":10}` — applied to us-west group.
carla: autoscaler metrics show node saturation on GPU mem; requesting burst nodes from dedicated pool.
alice: added +2 burst nodes (gpu-pool-burst-usw). Nodes are provisioning, IPs assigned.
david: warmup KV prefetch running for top 200 keys to lower miss rate.
matt: heads-up to support: some customers may see slower generations for a few minutes during fallback. @support-team please prepare messages.
support-team-bot: Ticket TKT-9012 created to notify affected customers (queued advisory).
bob: p95 dropped to ~700ms after canary and batch tweak, p99 trending down but still at ~1.1s.
alice: continuing to monitor. If p99 stays >1s for 10m we'll escalate to full-route rollback to older model variant.
carla: memory pressure easing on new nodes, KV miss rate halved.
david: p95 now ~260ms for last 2m, p99 ~420ms. Looks stable.
alice: PD-84219 — marking resolved in PD as metrics recovered and no ongoing customer errors.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-84219 resolved by alice
bob: follow-up: autoscaler scale-out threshold too conservative for bursty fanout; will open a PR with tuned thresholds + more aggressive burst pool strategy.
carla: I'll create the postmortem and assign action items (autoscaler tuning, routing fallback doc, support playbook).
alice: great work, team. Leaving a short bridge handoff note in the incident doc and closing thread. :heart:
